nc.name: line
nc.meaning: aircraft line: A350, A330, A320, A400M, Autre

nc.name: on_aec
nc.meaning: 1 when AEC (FTO2) is in the liability, so the NC is costed

nc.name: rule
nc.meaning: CNQ rule: RWK, REJ, REJ_RW, EXC, SCR, DQN, ..., DELETED

nc.name: where_found
nc.meaning: where the NC was found (CNQ model)

nc.name: cost_total
nc.meaning: CNQ level 3, per defect (EUR): the dashboard's cost

nc.name: cable
nc.meaning: 1 when a defect line is a cable defect (root-cause labels)

nc.name: scope
nc.meaning: serie = plant FTO2 or FT02; client = customer return (Type_NC_auto 'NC Retour client' with FTO2 in the liability); autre = the rest

nc.name: hour
nc.meaning: creation hour, Paris time (-1 if unknown)

nc.name: age_days
nc.meaning: days open at the data date (empty when closed)

nc.name: type_nc
nc.meaning: NC type: CABLES, TEST, INTERNE, CONTROLE FINAL, NC Interne, FOURNISSEUR, ...

nc.name: source
nc.meaning: sky (Skywise only), gps (also in the GPS register), test (also in the Test list)

nc.name: long_text
nc.meaning: NC long text, customer returns only (2,500 characters)

nc.name: work_source
nc.meaning: where the setup and hands-on minutes come from: order (planned time of the rework orders), model, or empty (no work)

nc.name: order_state
nc.meaning: rework orders: used, open (not closed yet), no_time, not_found (not in the operations), empty (no link or no operations)

nc.name: rework_orders
nc.meaning: rework order numbers (S03) linked to the NC, space-separated

nc.name: alert_source
nc.meaning: alert step: alea (declared time of the quality aléas that led to the NC), flat (the model's time), empty (not charged)

nc.name: aleas
nc.meaning: quality aléas (MES disruptions) that led to the NC, space-separated

nc.name: origin
nc.meaning: pipeline output the NC comes from: normal (fto2_dashboard_data) or missing_ids (fto2_dashboard_data_missing_ids)

defects.name: seq
defects.meaning: defect line number in the NC

defects.name: cost_alloc
defects.meaning: the NC's level-3 cost shared on this line (EUR)

defects.name: label_src
defects.meaning: ai (stored root-cause label) or parser (no label yet)

defects.name: ai_conf
defects.meaning: confidence of the stored label: high, medium, low

defects.name: cr_nature
defects.meaning: customer returns: damage type (phys, hs, nc, recu)

disruptions.name: opened
disruptions.meaning: day the aléa opened, Paris time

disruptions.name: line
disruptions.meaning: aircraft line, from the aléa's programme: A350, A330, A320, Autre

disruptions.name: minutes
disruptions.meaning: time lost, typed by the operator (minutes)

disruptions.name: in_block
disruptions.meaning: 1 when counted in the disruption block; 0 for the possible ERMA aléas (MIP / 1101VB), out until checked

disruptions.name: reason
disruptions.meaning: why out of the block: erma, or empty

disruptions.name: status
disruptions.meaning: status of the aléa in MES
